Studied: Climbing.description:
🧗 You trained at a bouldering gym, on outdoor rock or with a mountain club, and you know rope work and belaying.

🌱 Knots, anchors and reading a wall for holds. On a building, cliff or rubble pile you test each hold before trusting it.
⚠️ Smooth glass, blank overhangs, crumbling concrete and climbing while hurt are beyond you, and long climbs drain your stamina.
⚖️ Scaling a building in the city is trespass unless a hero or rescue operation directs it.
🏫 It shows in chalk-dry hands, calloused fingertips and an eye that maps holds on any wall.

📈 Grants: Climbing +15
Studied: Climbing.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has trained as a climber: bouldering, roped climbing, belaying, knots, anchors and reading a wall for holds. On a building, cliff or rubble pile they test each hold before trusting it and move one limb at a time. Prior study, not mastery: smooth glass, blank overhangs, crumbling concrete and climbing while injured are still beyond them, and a long climb drains their stamina. Not a license: scaling a building in the city is trespass unless a hero or rescue operation directs it. It shows in chalk-dry hands, calloused fingertips and an eye that maps holds on any wall.
